lines.t: Verse 1:
From the dust You formed us,
In mercy You called.
When we wandered in darkness,
Still You carried it all.
You came low in glory,
To lift us above—
O YahuShua, Holy One,
Our First and Only Love.
Verse 2:
You walked with the broken,
You healed with Your hand.
You spoke truth and mercy,
And taught us to stand.
You called twelve in silence,
To follow Your flame—
Now we walk in Your footsteps,
And honor Your Name.
All tears wiped away, by the hand of the King,
No more sorrow, no more pain, just the joy that You bring.
You have written our names in the Lamb’s Book of Life—
You have conquered the grave, You have ended the strife.
All tears wiped away… in the light of Your face.
Verse 3:
Every tribe and nation shall bow and confess,
The Name above all names—YAHUWAH is blessed.
The heavens resound it, the angels proclaim:
All creation now worships and blesses Your Name!
Worthy is the Lamb, who was slain and now lives,
To Him be the glory, all power He gives.
We are His Bride, made spotless and true,
Clothed in white linen, made forever new.
Final Chorus:
All tears wiped away, for the former is gone,
Now the dwelling of God is with man ever on.
He shall wipe every eye, He shall cast death away—
All things made new, at the breaking of day.
All tears wiped away…
All tears wiped away.
“Those who grab hold of their First Love,
with all their heart, with all their mind,
with all their strength and with all their soul...
shall never hunger nor thirst.
Nor shall the heat of the noonday sun do them any harm.
Yes, even all their tears shall be wiped away…
In the house of the Lord.”
